description: Boot the flow's server-side preview sandbox (Vite dev server) — or reconcile a running one to the flow's current files — and return its public HTTPS URL already pinned to this flow's mock dataset: the maker's pick, else its vertical's (sushi, not restaurant). Open the URL in a browser to see the app; call again after write_flow_files to sync. Previews idle-stop on their own; call stop_preview when done to free resources sooner.
name: flow_start_preview
title: Start (or sync) the live preview
